analysis.title: Expro Ltd. (XPRO): 3Q26 First Take: Softer EBITDA and FY26 Guide vs GS; Focus on 2027 Outlook
key_insights: XPRO reported 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $91 mil vs GS estimate of $95 mil and FactSet consensus of $96 mil. Revenue was in line at $440 mil vs GS $441 mil, and EBITDA margins were softer.

Adjusted EBITDA margin was 20.7%, 78 bps below the GS estimate. North and Latin America was 207 bps above GS, Europe and Sub Sahara Africa 296 bps below, and Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa 148 bps below.

Revenue by region vs GS: Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa -10% ($136 mil vs $151 mil), Europe and Sub Sahara Africa +3% ($149 mil vs $144 mil), North and Latin America +7% ($155 mil vs $146 mil). The company combined the MENA and APAC regions in reporting.

FY26 EBITDA guidance was cut to $330-340 mil from $355-365 mil, below GS at $355 mil and consensus at $350 mil. FY26 revenue guidance was narrowed to $1.66-1.68 bil from $1.65-1.7 bil, in line with GS and consensus at $1.67 bil.
4Q26 guidance implies revenue of $465-485 mil (GS $469 mil, consensus $467 mil) and EBITDA of $100-110 mil, below GS at $121 mil and consensus at $115 mil.

Management expects mid-teens growth in 2027 adjusted EBITDA and over 20% growth in adjusted free cash flow, including a full year contribution of Enhanced Drilling. GS says the focus is on the 2027 outlook.
GS reiterates Buy with a 12-month price target of $19 (19.7% upside from $15.87), based on the average of a 9.0% through-cycle FCF yield and 5.5x through-cycle EV/EBITDA.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Buy and $19 target after 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $91 mil missed GS ($95 mil) and the FY26 EBITDA guide was cut to $330-340 mil. The focus shifts to mid-teens 2027 adjusted EBITDA growth.

earnings_insights: XPRO 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA reported $91 mil vs GS estimate $95 mil and FactSet consensus estimate $96 mil.
XPRO 3Q26 total revenue reported $440 mil vs GS estimate $441 mil (-0.1%), up 11.9% sequentially and 6.9% y/y.
XPRO 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported $0.19 vs GS estimate $0.18, adjusted net income $21.7 mil vs GS $20.8 mil.
XPRO 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA margin reported 20.7% vs GS estimate 21.5% and 22.8% in 3Q25.

XPRO FY26 guidance (company): revenue $1.66-1.68 bil vs prior guide $1.65-1.7 bil, GS and consensus estimate $1.67 bil. EBITDA $330-340 mil vs prior guide $355-365 mil, GS estimate $355 mil, consensus estimate $350 mil.
XPRO 4Q26 guidance (company): revenue $465-485 mil vs GS estimate $469 mil and consensus estimate $467 mil. EBITDA $100-110 mil vs GS estimate $121 mil and consensus estimate $115 mil.
XPRO 2027 early expectations (company): mid-teens growth in adjusted EBITDA and over 20% growth in adjusted free cash flow, including a full year of Enhanced Drilling.
GS estimates (forecast): FY26E revenue $1,669.8 mil, EBITDA $354.8 mil, EPS $1.08. FY27E revenue $1,775.5 mil, EBITDA $379.1 mil, EPS $1.47. These GS FY26 estimates predate the guidance cut.
risk_factors: Slowdown in global drilling and completion activity.
Slower than expected rate of change in international oilfield markets.
